name: Twin Way
source:
Takada is the main character, a karate club member with a few bad habits. He is getting frusturated with being compared to his brother at every turn who started a dojo of his own.

He makes some friends over the internet and after meeting them his life begans to change, gradually he gets closer with more than a few girls and soon he arrives at a crossroads, which way will he chose his life to go?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1505]Getchu[/url]]
